result.final_text:
## What this letter says

This letter is about an appointment for your 20-week scan. The letter also calls it an "anomaly scan". The scan cannot find every problem.

## What you need to do

1. Go to your scan on Monday 11 January 2027 at 14:15.
2. Go to the Antenatal Clinic, Floor 1.
3. You do not need a full bladder for this scan.
4. You may bring 1 adult with you.
5. Do not bring children into the scan room. Children cannot come into the scan room.
6. Would an interpreter help you? If so, call the hospital at least 5 working days before your appointment. They will book one for free.

## Dates and medicines

- **Monday 11 January 2027 at 14:15:** your 20-week scan (anomaly scan). It is in the Antenatal Clinic, Floor 1.
- The letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor

- What does "anomaly scan" mean?
- What does "Antenatal Clinic" mean?
- What phone number do I call to book an interpreter? The letter does not give one.
- When will I get the results of my scan?

## When to get urgent help

Before your appointment, you may have any of these:

- bleeding
- fluid leaking from your vagina
- very bad (severe) tummy pain

If you do, call the Maternity Assessment Unit (MAU) straight away. The number is 01632 960 456. This line is open 24 hours.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
